title: Twice, half or rounding wrong (11 cards)
body:
- "Twice" missing: Chaotic Backlash, Devouring Hellion, Nuclear Fallout, Sage of the Maze, Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas
- "Copy each of those spells twice" copies once: Finale of Promise
- "Half, rounded up" encoded rounded down: Personal Incarnation, Split the Party, Torrent Sculptor
- "Half that many, rounded down" draws the full amount: Sokrates, Athenian Teacher
- Eternal Flame deals half X to the target and half X to you. It should deal X to the target and half X, rounded up, to you
